notes.title: Demo version update and bug fix
notes.content: [p]Demo version update and bug fix guide[/p][p][/p][p]Errors found after the BIC exhibition, puzzle-related play convenience, and additional icons have been made.[/p][p][/p][p]Sound and directional updates are scheduled, and we are planning to get it done as soon as possible. I hope the demo version looks the best from scratch, but I don't think so.[/p][p][/p][p]But I'm going to do my best to get closer to him. Bye![/p][p][/p][p]_ tinynap[/p]

notes.title: The demo version is now officially released!
notes.content:
[p]The demo of [i]The Nobody Woods: Lucy[/i] is now officially available.
We apologize for the delay beyond the planned release date, as the review process took longer than expected.
Enjoy playing – updates will be released from time to time.
We’ll be back soon with more news! ^^[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version Release Notice!!
notes.content:
[p]Hello! The demo for [i]The Nobody Woods: Lucy[/i] is still under review.
Due to scheduling issues, we had announced the demo release date in advance — but didn’t anticipate that the review process would still be ongoing 😢
We’ll release it as soon as it’s complete.[/p][p]Also!!! [i]The Nobody Woods: Lucy[/i] is making its first appearance at the [b]Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)[/b] in South Korea!
Both online and offline exhibitions are happening, and the [b]online exhibition is now live![/b][/p][p]See you soon! ^^[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703898/87a9510be2f725debd14a48878609d30a0f3573f.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://bicfest.org/index"]https://bicfest.org/index[/url][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to The Nobody Woods: Lucy.
notes.content:
[p]Hello.[/p][p]I’m TK, the sole developer at [i]tinynap[/i], currently working on [b]The Nobody Woods: Lucy[/b].[/p][p]First of all, thank you to everyone who has shown interest in [i]The Nobody Woods: Lucy[/i]. Though this store page is being revealed ahead of a small demo, I’d be truly grateful if players with a taste for something unique and atmospheric discover and look forward to it.[/p][p]What started as a simple story has grown to this point, and I consider it an honor.
This game tells the eerie yet playful tale of a boy named Lucy—where strange things happen when you let your guard down, plans go awry, and someone who seems friendly might actually be targeting Lucy.
In this unpredictable adventure, Lucy sets off on a journey to save his life.[/p][p]Just as Lucy is about to have his life stolen by a nightmare, he receives a blessing called [b]The Moon’s Blessing[/b]. This miracle separates the nightmare from Lucy and drops him into [b]The Nobody Woods[/b], a space between life and death.[/p][p]Now, as Lucy navigates traps of nightmares and faces countless dangers, he begins his journey to embrace his life and learn how to live alongside others. [b]Join Lucy on his journey.[/b][/p][p]The demo is scheduled for [b]August 8[/b]. Though I’m working solo, I’ll do my best to make it fulfilling. I’ll be back soon with more news.[/p][p]Oh—and please don’t forget to [b]add it to your wishlist and follow the page[/b].[/p][p]Thank you.
— TK[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703898/6efa71e57917e14bf5ff1ff119d0be52d13e4b3c.png"][/img][/p]
